title: Adding SAP LZC/LZH decompression library
description:
This adds SAP's proprietary implementation of the LZC/LZH compression algorithms, in order
to be used in SAP Diag and RFC dissectors.

The `csdecompr` code is based on [ClamSAP implementation](https://sourceforge.net/p/clamsap/git/ci/main/tree/src/csdecompr.c).
The benefit from using the ClamSAP implementation is that they have already done the work of
porting the original C++ implementation to plain C. In order to mantain the original code as
untouched as possible, the `saplzclzh.c` code acts as a wrapper of the `CsDecompr` "object".
The modifications made to the `csdecompr.c` implementation is only the removal of the
SAR archive file related code. The ClamSAP project is GPLv2 and license headers are kept
intact, with the exception of the wrong contact address that was replaced with the Web site.

The `saplzclzh.c` wrapper is mostly similar to the one present in [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/sapdecompress.cpp).
File `hpa101saptype.h` was kept exactly as in SecureAuth's plugin.

Test code was added using the test cases implemented in [pysap](https://github.com/OWASP/pysap/blob/master/tests/pysapcompress_test.py).

notes.body: I added the decompression library to wsutil based on the feedback provided in #11081. As mentioned in the body of the MR, I solved the initial issue of the C++ code by using an alternative "official" implementation from SAP.

I just updated again and got it working, so it should be solved.

Adding SAP LZC/LZH decompression library

This adds SAP's proprietary implementation of the LZC/LZH compression algorithms, in order
to be used in SAP Diag and RFC dissectors.

The `csdecompr` code is based on [ClamSAP implementation](https://sourceforge.net/p/clamsap/git/ci/main/tree/src/csdecompr.c).
The benefit from using the ClamSAP implementation is that they have already done the work of
porting the original C++ implementation to plain C. In order to mantain the original code as
untouched as possible, the `saplzclzh.c` code acts as a wrapper of the `CsDecompr` "object".
The modifications made to the `csdecompr.c` implementation is only the removal of the
SAR archive file related code. The ClamSAP project is GPLv2 and license headers are kept
intact, with the exception of the wrong contact address that was replaced with the Web site.

The `saplzclzh.c` wrapper is mostly similar to the one present in [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/sapdecompress.cpp).
File `hpa101saptype.h` was kept exactly as in SecureAuth's plugin. Move decompressor state off the stack, make the public header self-contained,
and handle continuation/boundary cases in the wrapper.

Test code was added using the test cases implemented in [pysap](https://github.com/OWASP/pysap/blob/master/tests/pysapcompress_test.py). Added focused wsutil tests for success and error
paths.
